resources.title: Newsletter January 2025: New Year, New Solutions
resources.excerpt: Kick off the new year with our latest newsletter featuring new product launches, industry insights, and exclusive offers for our valued partners.
resources.content:
Welcome to 2025! We're excited to share our first newsletter of the year, packed with updates on our latest product offerings and industry trends.

What's New

  • DLAB Scientific product line now available
  • Special promotion on Lovibond water testing equipment
  • New webinar series on food safety testing

Industry Insights

The laboratory equipment market in Indonesia continues to grow, driven by increasing quality standards in food, pharmaceutical, and environmental sectors. We're committed to providing cutting-edge solutions to meet these demands.

Stay tuned for more updates throughout the year!

resources.title: Introducing DLAB Scientific Laboratory Equipment
resources.excerpt: We're proud to announce our partnership with DLAB Scientific, bringing you comprehensive laboratory equipment solutions from centrifuges to incubators.
resources.content:
PT Abhipraya Nawasena Sejahtera is thrilled to announce our new partnership with DLAB Scientific, a leading manufacturer of laboratory equipment.

Product Highlights

  • High-Speed Refrigerated Centrifuges
  • Precision Analytical Balances
  • Digital Water Baths & Dry Bath Incubators
  • Orbital Shakers & Vortex Mixers

Why DLAB?

DLAB Scientific is known for their reliability, precision, and excellent after-sales support. All products come with comprehensive warranties and technical documentation.

Contact us for product catalogs and quotations!

resources.title: ANS Hosts Successful Laboratory Equipment Seminar
resources.excerpt: Over 100 laboratory professionals attended our recent seminar on modern analytical techniques and equipment selection.
resources.content:
Last week, we successfully hosted a seminar on "Modern Laboratory Equipment and Best Practices" at our Bekasi office.

Key Topics Covered

  • Water quality testing with Lovibond equipment
  • Rapid microbiology testing methods
  • Sterilization monitoring and validation
  • Laboratory automation trends

Participant Feedback

"The seminar was incredibly informative. The hands-on demonstrations really helped us understand the equipment capabilities." - Dr. Sarah, QC Manager

Thank you to all participants! We plan to hold more events throughout 2025.
